episodes.synopsis: A self-described mad scientist attends a lecture on time travel, stumbles upon the dead body of a familiarly unfamiliar woman, and discovers that his text messages are no longer bound by the rules of space and time.
episodes.title: Turning Point

episodes.synopsis: Okabe is surprised to see Makise up and about after she was killed.
episodes.title: Time Travel Paranoia

episodes.synopsis: Okabe suspects his microwave oven is behind the recent unusual events.
episodes.title: Parallel World Paranoia

episodes.synopsis: Okabe needs to find a very old computer to hack a very new tech.
episodes.title: Interpreter Rendezvous

episodes.synopsis: A successful hack reveals SERN's big secret.
episodes.title: Starmine Rendezvous

episodes.synopsis: Okabe's small scale experiment is partially successful.
episodes.title: Butterfly Effect's Divergence

episodes.synopsis: Okabe takes his experimentation to the next level by texting the winning lotto numbers back in time, but he fails to consider how his actions might alter the present - or the future.
episodes.title: Divergence Singularity

episodes.synopsis: The latest experiment for Okabe and his lab mates leads to the disappearance of one of their own. Next, they'll attempt to use their time travel technology to make a young boy's dream a reality.
episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis I

episodes.synopsis: Okabe grows concerned over the drastic changes his experimentation is causing, and the IBN-5100 disappears from the lab. The only hope for finding a replacement rests upon the delicate shoulders of Feyris the cat girl.
episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis II

episodes.synopsis: The part-time warrior from downstairs tells Okabe about the search for her missing father. Meanwhile, the aspiring mad scientist is troubled by a mysterious text message.
episodes.title: Chaos Theory Homeostasis III

episodes.synopsis: As the lab members prepare to transport human memories by way of a Time Leap, Okabe receives some highly disturbing news: Makise may be a SERN spy!
episodes.title: Dogma in Event Horizon

episodes.synopsis: Tension builds at the Lab when Makise and Suzuha both show up for the party, but that's just the beginning. As the night draws to a close, armed thugs - led by a familiar face - come looking for the time machine.
episodes.title: Dogma in Ergosphere

episodes.synopsis: Okabe, desperate to prevent the tragedy he's already seen happen, summons the courage for a daring  and risky Time Leap. Can he save the life of his oldest and dearest companion?
episodes.title: Metaphysics Necrosis

episodes.synopsis: Despite his many attempts, Okabe is unable to prevent the death of Mayuri, so he turns to Makise for help solving the riddle of time travel. Later, Suzuha's true identity is revealed
episodes.title: Physically Necrosis

episodes.synopsis: Suzuha reveals the orgins of SERN's future totalitarianism. While she continues her work to destroy the organization, Okabe and Mayuri continue the search for Suzuha's father.
episodes.title: Missing Link Necrosis

episodes.synopsis: The truth about Suzuha's father is finally revealed. Okabe realizes the devastating consequences of stopping her from leaving the night of the party.
episodes.title: Sacrificial Necrosis

episodes.synopsis: After the change in divergence fails to have a lasting effect, Okabe and Kurisu set out to further manipulate time in the hopes of gaining an IBN 5100.
episodes.title: Made in Complex

episodes.synopsis: In a further attempt to rescue Mayuri from her fate, Okabe reveals Ruka's past to her. Ruka must make a difficult decision that might change her entire life.
episodes.title: Fractal Androgynous

episodes.synopsis: Okabe must make a time leap in order to save Moeka from herself. He realizes that all is not what it seems as Moeka's shady behavior leads him closer to the IBN 5100.
episodes.title: Endless Apoptosis

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Kurisu and Moeka, Okabe attempts to get closer to the IBN 5100 and the mysterious FB. As he closes in on SERN's network, he realizes that the path to victory will not be without additional sacrifice.
episodes.title: Finalize Apoptosis

episodes.synopsis: With his new discovery in mind, Okabe continues his attempts to protect Mayuri while also trying to avoid Kurisu's potential impending fate.
episodes.title: Paradox Meltdown

episodes.synopsis: In order to continue his work against SERN, Okabe must finally choose between saving Kurisu or Mayuri.
episodes.title: Being Meltdown

episodes.synopsis: Tasked with preventing an impending World War III by an alternate Suzuha, Okabe finds himself playing an active part in Kurisu's death.
episodes.title: Open the Steins Gate

episodes.synopsis: Okabe has one final chance to travel back in time, set everything right, and save the girl he never even got to love. His mission is vital, but it may mean the end for the mad scientist.
episodes.title: Achievement Point
